opponents.name: Painter Jericho
opponents.meet_text: The evening sun is the most perfect time to come here and paint... or play cards!
opponents.repeat_text: I've been painting a lot of great pieces from this spot.
opponents.first_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.rematch_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.loss_text: To win is a beautiful piece of art.

opponents.name: Engineer Allan
opponents.meet_text: As you can see, the new bulb installation went perrrrfectly today. I'm worn out from all the steps but always game for a match.
opponents.repeat_text: I won't be needing to replace the bulb any time soon so I've got time to kill.
opponents.first_win_text: That was clearly toooooo many steps today.
opponents.rematch_win_text: At least I'm reaaallly good at replacing bulbs.
opponents.loss_text: I hope your loss didn't come as a shock to you.

opponents.name: Birdspotter Tamsin
opponents.meet_text: These Palms attract a lot of Bird Pokemon so its a good spot to watch them.
opponents.repeat_text: Looking for more Birds round here?
opponents.first_win_text: I wish I could just fly away.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You can't fly away from all your troubles.
opponents.loss_text: You should try bird watching with me!

opponents.name: Firebreather Darryl
opponents.meet_text: I've been breathing that much fire that I needed an ice cold bev to cool my mouth down, but I'm ready for a match if you want.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm fired up and ready for another match if you want.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could teach you how to firebreath... but maybe you should teach me how to play cards better!
opponents.loss_text: That juice was just what I needed!

opponents.name: Firebreather Kenneth
opponents.meet_text: I'm so used to hot drinks that it's weird to drink something nice and cold.
opponents.repeat_text: If you want another match then let's goooooo.
opponents.first_win_text: I have too many burns to battle well.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll just stick to the firebreathing from now on, I'm good at that.

opponents.name: Psychic Brienne
opponents.meet_text: I love the peace of the harbour at night, the sound of the waves in the dark are really relaxing.
opponents.repeat_text: It's easier to meditate at night.
opponents.first_win_text: I have to focus more. Take these cards to help you focus more too.

opponents.name: Bad Dude Wayne
opponents.meet_text: I caught these bad looking dudes heading to the forest and they gave me some interesting cards and went on their way.
opponents.first_win_text: You even seen a Dark Pokemon before?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I need some more of these Dark cards.
